lines.text: Totoy? By the lanterns, it is you. I thought the road had swallowed you.
You are carrying a beacon key. May I see it? Careful, it is cracked straight through.
Cracked, and still humming. The Heartloom is not finished with you yet.
Look at the hills. Five beacons dark, one glowing weakly. That one belongs to the forest.
Find Tovan at the forge and Edda by her hut. Then take the east road. I will wait here.
The east road leads to the forest, and the forest holds the nearest beacon song.
Tovan and Edda know things I only draw on maps. Talk to them before you go.
Edda sent you after the Thornback Stag? She does not trust many people with that.
The root gate in the forest is stuck. Two lanterns must be lit before the roots let go.
Come back when the beacon burns. I will have the next region marked for you.
Hold it up to the light. That is a Black Katana, and it is yours. It was always yours.
Worn, but the edge is honest. Mind the weight. A blade like that rewards patience.
Dash is your best friend out there. It carries you through trouble faster than a sword can.
Remember the colours. Gold attacks can be parried. Red attacks, you dodge. No exceptions.
Try it on the training post by my forge. It will not hit back, which is more than I can say for the forest.
Swing at the post until dashing feels like breathing.
Gold, parry. Red, dash. Say it until you stop thinking about it.
Bring me anything strange from the forest. I will tell you what it is, and what it is worth.
So the key came home, and so did you. Sit a moment, Totoy. Listen.
The creatures in the forest were not always like this. Something frightened their hearts.
When one falls, a fragment of its power is left behind. Most people would let it fade.
I teach another way. You can bind that fragment, without destroying what remains of it.
Open the character menu with Tab and put an Aspect in a skill slot. It will answer to you.
The Thornback Stag, past the root gate, is calm enough to bind. Find it, and be gentle.
The Stag guards its glade beyond the root gate. Light both lanterns to open the way.
Tab opens the character menu. Check your Aspects before you meet it.
A bound power is a loan, not a gift. Treat it as one.
The Night of Returning Lights was never quiet before. Now only one hill answers.
The shrine remembers every song, even the ones we have forgotten.
You walk like someone who has lost something. I know that walk well.
Go and listen at the shrine, if you like. Songs return to those who listen.
Edda has taught you to bind? Then the old ways are not dead after all.
Do not waste what you bind, child. The valley has little power left to spare.
May the lanterns guide you. They have guided every Waykeeper before you.
Are you the one with the broken key? Everyone is talking about it.
I saw a light in the forest last night. It was not a lantern. It was blue.
Mama says I must not go there. Will you tell me what you find?
These crates are for the beacon hill. If the beacon ever lights again, they will be ready.
Mind the east road. Mosslings have been creeping out of the forest after dark.
They are slow, but they hit hard. Learn the colours before you meet one.
